text: Implemented BIDS scan and metadata accessors: funcScans, preprocScans, anatScans, grouped summaries by subject/task, BidsMetadataRecord, BidsRepetitionTime, scanMetadata, func/preproc scan metadata helpers, repetitionTimes, and inferRepetitionTime with VolumeTiming fallback. Added shared selector/summary/metadata/TR tests and JVM fixture coverage for disk-loaded sidecar-derived metadata/TR. Updated module README and ecosystem port notes. Verification: sbt bidsJVM/test bidsJS/test passed 38 JVM / 34 JS tests; sbt compileAll testAll exited 0; source scan found no explicit return/throw or upward imports from shared BIDS.
